All stages inherit these rules and the Limits, Incident policy and Artifact lifecycle below. Stage instructions add requirements; omission never grants an exception.

`task STAGE` prints inherited policy and current actions. `advance STAGE EVENT` checks a legal edge and prints the next task, only after the orchestrator verifies completion. `resume PRIOR-STAGE` requires a verified prior checkpoint and Incident policy’s authorization. This stateless dispatcher neither executes/persists runs, certifies evidence nor grants authorization. Owning tools control execution, accounting, storage, claims and publication; semantic gates remain orchestrator obligations. Persist each verified next stage with project checkpoint tools; stop conditions override progression.
